# Network operations platform

### 4.1 Incident handling
The supplier shall issue an early warning of any significant incident within 24 hours, an incident notification within 72 hours and a final report within one month.

### 4.2 Governance
The management bodies of the supplier shall approve the cybersecurity risk-management measures and follow training on cybersecurity risks.

### 4.3 Supply chain
The supplier shall assess and manage the security risks of its direct suppliers and service providers.

### 4.4 High availability
The network operations platform shall provide a multi-region high-availability topology with automatic failover and zero data loss (RPO = 0, RTO < 30 seconds).

### 4.5 Latency and telemetry throughput
The edge telemetry pipeline shall ingest and process streaming metrics with end-to-end latency strictly below 50 milliseconds at 100,000 events per second.
